text.title: Butterflyfish
text.nearby: A yellow butterflyfish swims by the coral.
text.about_looks: A flat, bright yellow fish with a dark bar on its side. A long thread trails from its back fin.
text.about_food: It eats coral polyps and tiny reef animals and soft green algae. It picks small bites from the reef.
text.about_home: It lives by coral and rocks on the reef. It slips into cracks to rest.
text.about_winter: It stays awake all year. It swims by the reef every day.
text.about_young: Young are born from tiny eggs in the water. They drift in the water and then live near the reef.
text.about_fact: The long thread on its back fin trails behind it as it swims.
text.menu_sub: Flit between the corals and pick at algae and tiny animals.
text.menu_wild: Bigger fish hunt on the reef.
text.hungry: You're hungry. Look for algae and tiny animals on the coral.
text.no_food: Nothing to eat here. Look for algae and tiny animals on the coral.
